start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: You leave the box with Kronos and see a room full of cats doing something you weren't expecting: partying--

TI1.speaker: Narrator
TI1.text: --clinking cups, cheering, spilling milk on their brown furs and metal shields, discarded at their feet. Some of them are talking, others are throwing dice and calculating throws.

TI2.speaker: Narrator
TI2.text: They look like soldiers just returned from a war, celebrating a great victory.

TI3.speaker: Narrator
TI3.text: Kronos puts a paw around your shoulders and guides you through the multitude.

TI6.speaker: Kronos
TI6.text: Don't get drunk or you'll lose. No one can hold their alcohol like Mercury.

TI8.speaker: Narrator
TI8.text: Kronos looks very proud of himself.

TI13.speaker: Narrator
TI13.text: A booming voice interrupts your conversation.

TI14.speaker: Kronos
TI14.text: Tsk. There he is. Be careful, kitty.

TI15.speaker: Narrator
TI15.text: You are about to protest when Kronos pushes you forward and you stumble at the feet of a very...

TI16.speaker: Narrator
TI16.text: ...small, fluffy, spiky cat with tiny eyes and brown fur.

TI17.speaker: Narrator
TI17.text: You glance back, but Kronos has disappeared.

TI19.text: Who's this little kitty? A follower of Kronos's?

TI21.speaker: Narrator
TI21.text: Mercury, the trickster, God of commerce and thieves, laughs in your face.

TI22.speaker: Narrator
TI22.text: You can smell the alcohol in his breath.

TI23.speaker: Mercury
TI23.text: You're here for the can of tuna ol' Kronos lost? I'm surprised you would wager your soul for him!

TI24.speaker: Narrator
TI24.text: Mercury slams his paw into the table and interrupts your thoughts about the soul-trading. Four stone dice on the table shake.

end.speaker: Mercury
end.text: Then join me for a round of Tali, and let the dice decide your fate!
